datasets.name: CAS landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: This study employs the CAS landslide dataset [38]. Developed specifically for deep learning applications, the dataset is publicly available on Zenodo (https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10294997).

datasets.name: GF-1 satellite data (Longxi River Dataset)
datasets.source: China Center for Resources Satellite Data and Application
datasets.verbatim: The dataset comprises 1769 images, acquired from the GF-1 satellite data (0.5 m resolution) provided by the China Center for Resources Satellite Data and Application

datasets.name: UAV images (Moxi Town Dataset)
datasets.verbatim: The dataset comprises 1635 UAV images acquired by the Sichuan Geographic Information Center between September and October 2022

datasets.name: Hokkaido Iburi-Tobu Dataset imagery
datasets.verbatim: This subset includes 1484 images acquired by the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan between September and October 2018

methods.name: E-MSLDNet (edge-aware and multiscale feature fusion dual-enhanced landslide detection network)
methods.summary: E-MSLDNet is a semantic segmentation network based on an improved ResNet50 backbone. It incorporates a Multiscale Feature Aggregation Attention (MSFAA) module for multiscale feature representation, an Edge-Aware Attention Module (EAAM) for direction-sensitive boundary capture, and an Edge-Enhanced Fusion Module (EEFM) for refining boundary delineation through spatial attention-guided calibration.
methods.verbatim: In this study, we draw upon the classical DeepLabV3+ model architecture [43] to propose an enhanced landslide segmentation network (E-MSLDNet), as illustrated in figure 3.

availability.author_statement: "No new data were created or analysed in this study."

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced and linked via the CAS landslide dataset, but the custom code for E-MSLDNet is not provided or linked, and the artifact availability statement confirms no code was shared.
